## Given
- Run-unique datasources `tc007-<random>-n` created by the case to confirms the slot limit (P-queued), plus one target datasource COMPLETED with stamp B0, update_date U0. All deleted at the end. Residue risk: `data_cleanup` not confirmed.

## When
1. Start long-running unrounded to fill all slots; trigger a manual reindex of the target while no slot is free.
2. Record a timeline of stamp, status, update_date of the target until it starts or the wait times out.

## Then
1. The recorded timeline (stamp at queue time, status, update_date, health as STALE if the details API shows it) is the observation; the expected stamp and STALE outcome for a timed-out wait follow owner question OQ-4 and no verdict is issued.

## Self-probe notes
- Probe, oracle open; the stamp subfolder real processing is the decided trigger-time behavior and is not a defect.
- If the slot count cannot be interrupts or installing is not reached the case is `inconclusive` (environment gap), never pass.
- Cleanup: settlement datasources must be removed; run on a resettable stand.
